text_5b0466f99b8d: Open as a work report proposal
text_5c1c93ed3826: Use planned data as a proposal
text_0e5619923a68: Yes adds a journey with planned departure/arrival, start/destination and rotation name. Then enter the train number. If needed, duty end is extended to the planned duty end, at least to arrival. Duty start and existing journeys are retained. No report is sent.
text_5cd750b403a3: Prepare a new work report draft
text_1b2e9cf12694: Add a journey draft: stations, planned times and rotation name
text_8dbd9458ced8: Open an editable report and finish any active GPS recording before adding the planned duty as a new journey.
text_cfe3bd6b67cc: This duty does not contain a complete journey that can be added. Check departure, arrival, start/destination and rotation name (up to 200 characters).
text_e4cbebe9734c: New journey added from the roster. Enter the train number now.
text_045c329d1843: Your confirmed selection replaces duty times in the current draft. Existing journeys are retained; the proposed journey is added.
text_efeaf6a3291f: This planned journey is already in the draft.
text_5f28db9a6f5d: Open the roster from the current report and select a planned duty. The question asks whether to add it as a NEW journey. Yes copies its departure/arrival dates and times, stations and rotation name. Then enter the train number. If needed, duty end extends to the planned duty end, at least to arrival. An already later end is never shortened. The extension is shown before confirmation. Duty start and previous journeys remain. No or Escape changes nothing. No report is sent. If departure precedes duty start, check the start or open the appropriate report. Extending a synchronized report requires an editable draft or a return for correction. Locked reports and active GPS recordings prevent applying it.
text_c87849cb4cfc: Do you want to add this planned duty as a NEW journey to the current work report?
text_84b7f2e6da1d: The planned journey starts before the current duty or the duty period is incomplete. Check the duty period or open the appropriate report.
text_892509c303c5: A synchronized report’s duty end cannot be extended here. Use an editable draft or request that the report be returned for correction.
